fao56.citation: Allen, R.G., Pereira, L.S., Raes, D., Smith, M. (1998). Crop evapotranspiration: guidelines for computing crop water requirements. FAO Irrigation and Drainage Paper 56.

tables_used.table_12: Single crop coefficients Kc and maximum crop height (same page)
tables_used.table_22: Maximum rooting depth and depletion fraction p (https://www.fao.org/4/x0490e/x0490e0e.htm)

fao56.note: Values are approximations for planning, per FAO-56 itself. Stage lengths come from other regions and are not Ontario-specific.

aquacrop.citation: AquaCrop-OSPy (Python implementation of the FAO AquaCrop model), v3.1.0, built-in soil presets (aquacrop/entities/soil.py) and crop library (aquacrop/entities/crops/crop_params.py). Foster, T. et al.
aquacrop.note: Model default parameters, typical values rather than measurements. heat_threshold_c is the crop's Tmax_up: the air temperature above which pollination begins to fail. Has no entries for clover or cereal rye.

omafra.citation: OMAFRA (Ontario Ministry of Agriculture, Food and Agribusiness): Agronomy Guide for Field Crops, Publication 811, and related crop-production factsheets.
omafra.note: Cited for qualitative rotation principles and planting/harvest windows. Specific pages still need to be linked entry by entry.

team_assumption.citation: Value chosen by the project team, not yet tied to a published source.
team_assumption.note: Anything sourced only to this must show 'Assumed' in the app and be replaced by a citation if one is found.
